'''[[House Blackcrest]]''' won the war the way it wins everything: by writing it down afterward. Keeper of the [[Chronicle of Victory]], the most influential and most despised house at once — every house scorns it, and every house has quietly been its client. Its doctrine: ''the Clean Page is not made of lies — it is made of true things, chosen.''
